test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In India, the Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) appointed in 2025 is ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Justice V. Ramasubramanian**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• **Shri Justice V. Ramasubramanian**, a former judge of the **Supreme Court of India**, was appointed as the **Chairperson** of the **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** in **2025**.

• The **Chairperson** and members of the NHRC are appointed by the **President of India** on the recommendations of a high-powered committee chaired by the **Prime Minister**.

• He succeeded **Shri Justice Arun Kumar Mishra**, who had been serving as the Chairperson since June 2021.

• The **Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019**, stipulates that a person who has been a **Judge of the Supreme Court** (in addition to a retired Chief Justice of India) is eligible to be appointed as the Chairperson of the NHRC.

• **Shri Justice H.L. Dattu** and **Shri Justice K.G. Balakrishnan** are former Chairpersons who served their respective terms prior to Justice Arun Kumar Mishra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** of India is a **Statutory public body** constituted on **12 October 1993** under the **Protection of Human Rights Ordinance**.

• It was given a statutory basis by the **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 (PHRA)**.

• The headquarters of the NHRC is located in **New Delhi**.

• The **Selection Committee** for the NHRC includes the **Prime Minister** (Chairperson), the **Speaker of the Lok Sabha**, the **Union Home Minister**, the **Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**, and the **Leaders of the Opposition** in both Houses of Parliament.

• The term of office for the Chairperson and members is **three years** or until they attain the age of **70 years**, whichever is earlier.

• **Justice Ranganath Misra** was the **first Chairperson** of the National Human Rights Commission.
